UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Playbeat Digital customer or admin profile synced from Firebase Auth (Google, Facebook, GitHub, TikTok OIDC, Phone SMS).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified email address if provided by the auth provider.

phoneNumber.description: E.164 phone number for SMS sign-in users.

provider.description: Primary Firebase sign-in provider identifier (google.com, facebook.com, github.com, oidc.tiktok, phone).

role.description: Access control role; non-admins are strictly restricted to customer.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last sign-in or profile update.

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: User-saved Playbeat LIVE TV channel bookmark.

channelId.description: Channel identifier matching the document ID.

channelName.description: Display name of the saved TV channel.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profiles containing PII (email, phoneNumber). Strictly readable/writable by the owning user or verified admin only.

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{channelId}.description: Per-user Playbeat LIVE TV watchlist subcollection. Owner-only read/write access.
